summary: Customer-owned recommendation decisions exposed through the canonical Subject Home boundary: one owner/admin-checked server action writes exactly one authoritative decisions-ledger call; the read model projects the latest durable decision. accepted/rejected/modified are fully operable; modified requires a bounded non-empty refinement note and is recorded through the same record_decision RPC (additive migration 20260807150000_decision_vocabulary_modified.sql widened the decisions.decision CHECK). superseded remains honest in the projection and is never fabricated as success.

object.targetLinkage: record_decision validates recommendation -> intelligence_run -> subject (kernel-owned); product layer pre-checks the same linkage and fails closed with zero writes

decisionLedger.unsupportedReason: superseded is a kernel/worker transition value; it stays honest in the projection (display state decided_other) and is never mapped to accepted/free/success. recommendation_outcomes admits accepted/rejected/modified but requires a bounded observation window (window_start/window_end) and is the outcomes ledger for efficacy observation, NOT the decision ledger; using it as a substitute decision ledger without an observation window is prohibited.
decisionLedger.supersededHandling: superseded remains honest in the projection (display state decided_other); never mapped to accepted/free/success.

writeSemantics.validSubmission: exactly one allowlisted record_decision RPC call
writeSemantics.modified: exactly one record_decision RPC call with p_decision='modified' and the bounded refinement note; blank note -> zero writes (missing_note); oversized note -> zero writes (malformed)
writeSemantics.duplicate: zero writes; idempotent ok with the existing decision id
writeSemantics.unsupported: zero writes; superseded/garbage returns an explicit unsupported message, never success
writeSemantics.unauthorized: zero writes; opaque 'Recommendation not found.' (no existence leak)
writeSemantics.wrongSubject: zero writes; product pre-check plus kernel RPC backstop
writeSemantics.persistenceFailure: exactly one attempted write surfaced as an error, never success

projection.latestDecision: decisions rows ordered by created_at desc, then id desc; first row per target wins (deterministic regardless of query order)
projection.modifiedProjection: a durable modified decision projects as display state 'modified' with its refinement note and no further decision controls
projection.rejectedSuppression: a recommendation whose latest durable decision is rejected is suppressed from actionable surfaces (Overview active list and Recommendations tab) until a NEW recommendation row with new evidence/run exists; rejection recurrence is tied to the durable decision
projection.clientState: client mirrors a decision ONLY after the server action confirms the write; the decisions ledger remains the authoritative source and the read model re-projects on every load

experience.controls: Accept/Reject/Refine buttons rendered only for proposed recommendations with no durable decision; Refine opens a bounded note input (maxLength 500) with Save refinement / Cancel
experience.loading: all decision controls disabled while a decision is pending; spinner on the active control
experience.errorRecovery: bounded role=alert error; cleared on the next attempt; the refinement form stays open so the note can be corrected and retried
experience.accessibility: native button elements with text labels and aria-labels; labeled textarea for the refinement note
experience.targetSize: size=lg (h-11 = 44px) decision and refinement controls in flex-wrap containers for the 390px composition

fixtureNote: Fixtures prove software contracts only; they do not prove live RLS behavior, creator efficacy, retention, conversion, or business impact. network_calls=0, provider_calls=0.
